Pure White Oath Lyra

UR Celestial Spirit · ATK bonus

Introduced Event · 12 Jun 2026 JST Pure White Oath

Blessed Harp

Lv.1

Deals damage equal to 300% of the average ATK of all allies to all enemies every 12 sec. Also grants all allies for 3 sec, [Top] Continuous Heal and [Top] DEF Increase.

Lv.2

Deals damage equal to 400% of the average ATK of all allies to all enemies every 12 sec. Also grants all allies for 4 sec, [Top] Continuous Heal and [Top] DEF Increase.

Lv.3

Deals damage equal to 500% of the average ATK of all allies to all enemies every 12 sec. Also grants all allies for 5 sec, [Top] Continuous Heal and [Top] DEF Increase.

NoteThe English game text for this skill is cut off, so the full text here is corrected from the Japanese client.

Known issue · Truncated TextThe English description is cut off in the game. On the card, which shows Lv.1, the text says the skill grants all allies "[Top] Continuous Heal and" and then stops, so the second effect does not appear. The Japanese text lists two buffs at every level: [Top] Continuous Heal and [Top] DEF Increase. The wiki records both effects. The damage (300%, 400% and 500% of all allies' average ATK every 12 sec) and the 3, 4 and 5 sec durations come from the Japanese.

Star progression

Owned bonus: +100% ATK at 0 stars, +100% for each star. Skill Lv.2 unlocks at ★1, Lv.3 at red ★2 (★7).
